units.rawText: We used to be Simo's possibilities. And now Simo... is Cyclopes's possibility.

units.rawText: The base code of every Agent in Cyclopes comes from one Doll's combat data. You could say each Agent in Cyclopes is one branch of his possibilities. But... to him, we were probably the worst possible outcome.

units.rawText: Yet that Doll has now cut his own chains and been reborn under your guidance. Thank you, Professor. Seeing Simo by your side makes me truly happy.
